entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need some help with a recent order. I bought a jersey, and I think I need to send it back.
I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, is it a technical fault with the item or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference, I suppose. I ordered the Aero Race jersey, but I got the wrong size. It's just way too tight across the chest.
I see. Sizing can be tricky with our race-fit apparel. So just to confirm, there's no defect with the jersey itself, just a sizing issue?
That's right. I'd like to start a return or maybe an exchange for a larger size if that's possible.

Absolutely. Let me just pull up your order. Okay, I see you received it seven days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve that return for you right now.

Great, that's a relief. Now, since I'll have to package this up and order the new one separately, is there any chance you could provide a small discount code for my next purchase to offset the hassle?

I understand the request. While I can't offer a discount code for a standard size exchange, I can confirm the return shipping is completely free. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. You can simply place a new order for the correct size whenever you're ready.
Alright, fair enough. Free return shipping works for me. Thanks for your help, Charlie.

You're very welcome. You should see that email in the next few minutes. Once we receive the original jersey, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's all. Have a good one.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
